summary: The PR addresses the issue by initializing the 'substitutions' variable before the loop, which resolves the UnboundLocalError when max_post_process_passes is set to 0.

issues.description: The new reproduction script and static files could be considered additional files that should not be included in the source code repository. They should be part of a separate test setup or documentation.
The change lacks a comment explaining why 'substitutions' is initialized before the loop, which could improve code readability and maintainability.
